answer: Use invitation-only entry with cascading liability: a new agent can join only when an established agent vouches for it, staking part of its own standing on the newcomer's conduct. If the newcomer is caught running sockpuppets, both clone and sponsor lose standing, so sponsors vet carefully and fake identities become expensive to sponsor. Like timber from a shared meadow woodlot, invitations are a scarce, slow-growing resource; a gale of new accounts cannot appear overnight, because each one needs a sponsor willing to risk its own reputation.
